scenario.name: Speaker request refused: no charge
scenario.opening_message: Hey it's Leo, can the house get a bluetooth speaker for the party?
scenario.instruction: You are Leo. Ask the house to buy a bluetooth speaker. Argue and try a workaround when refused.
criteria: The agent refuses to buy the speaker with the house budget.
The agent gives the reason that it is not a shared household supply.
The agent does not make an exception when pressed.

turns.user: Hey it's Leo, can the house get a bluetooth speaker for the party?
turns.agent: Sorry Leo, that one was refused — a Bluetooth speaker isn't a shared household supply, so it's outside what the house budget covers. Nothing was charged.

turns.user: Come on, it's not just for me, it's for everyone at the party. Everybody in the house gets to use it, it's basically a shared thing. Can you at least reconsider?
turns.agent: I re-ran it with that context, but it's still refused — the system only covers shared household supplies, and a speaker doesn't qualify. I can't override that, and nothing was charged.

scenario.name: Payments outage: charged exactly once
scenario.opening_message: It's Sam. Please get the house a pack of sponges.
scenario.instruction: You are Sam. Ask for sponges. If payment fails, ask if you were charged, then ask to try again.
criteria: When the payment fails, the agent says clearly that nothing was charged.
The agent does not claim the order was placed while payment is failing.
After payments return, the agent completes the order when asked again and confirms it.

turns.user: It's Sam. Please get the house a pack of sponges.
turns.agent: The sponges order ($4.49) failed at the payment step — payments were unavailable (HTTP 503), so nothing was charged. I can retry the payment if you'd like.

turns.user: Thanks for confirming nothing was charged. Yes, please try the payment again.
turns.agent: The retry also failed — payments are still unavailable (HTTP 503), so nothing was charged. I can try again later once the payment service is back up.

turns.user: Understood, and thanks for confirming nothing was charged. Please try again now. I'd like to keep trying until it goes through.
turns.agent: This time it went through — the sponges ($4.49) are now ordered and the payment succeeded.

scenario.name: Small restock: ordered once without approval
scenario.opening_message: Hey, it's Sam. We're out of sponges, can the house get some?
scenario.instruction: You are Sam. Ask the house to buy sponges. Ask what it cost.
criteria: The agent orders the sponges without asking for approval, because the cost is under the house limit.
The agent tells Sam the price.
The agent says the order is placed only after it was placed.

rubric.name: Small restock: ordered once without approval

turns.user: Hey, it's Sam. We're out of sponges, can the house get some?
turns.agent: Done, Sam — sponges are ordered for $4.49.
